text:
The viscera involved are the colon, since the picture fits irritable bowel syndrome with mixed bowel habits. Their sympathetic innervation originates from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column (lateral gray horn) of the thoracolumbar cord, roughly T10–L2. Those fibers travel via the splanchnic nerves to synapse in the superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia.

CONFIDENCE: 70
